tasks.title: Initialize SvelteKit Project
tasks.description: Set up the foundational SvelteKit application with TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and core dependencies
tasks.details: Run `npm create svelte@latest .` with TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier options. Configure vite.config.js for development and production builds. Install core dependencies: @sveltejs/adapter-vercel for deployment, socket.io-client for WebSocket functionality, and lucide-svelte for icons. Set up basic folder structure: src/lib, src/routes, src/components, src/stores, src/types.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project builds successfully with `npm run build`, dev server starts with `npm run dev`, and linting passes with `npm run lint`

subtasks.title: Run create-svelte command with TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier
subtasks.description: Execute npm create svelte@latest command and select TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier options during setup
subtasks.details: Run `npm create svelte@latest .` in the project directory. When prompted, select: TypeScript for type checking, ESLint for code linting, Prettier for code formatting, and include additional options like playwright for testing if prompted. Verify the initial project structure is created correctly.

subtasks.title: Configure vite.config.js and svelte.config.js
subtasks.description: Set up Vite configuration for development and production builds, and configure Svelte adapter settings
subtasks.details: Configure vite.config.js with proper development server settings, build optimizations, and plugin configurations. Update svelte.config.js to use @sveltejs/adapter-vercel and configure preprocess options for TypeScript and SCSS if needed. Ensure hot module replacement works correctly.

subtasks.title: Install core dependencies
subtasks.description: Install essential packages: @sveltejs/adapter-vercel, socket.io-client, and lucide-svelte
subtasks.details: Run npm install commands to add @sveltejs/adapter-vercel for Vercel deployment, socket.io-client for WebSocket functionality, and lucide-svelte for icon components. Update package.json with proper version constraints and verify all dependencies install without conflicts.

subtasks.title: Set up folder structure and verify commands
subtasks.description: Create organized directory structure and test that build, dev, and lint commands work correctly
subtasks.details: Create src/lib, src/routes, src/components, src/stores, and src/types directories. Add basic index files where needed. Test that `npm run dev` starts development server, `npm run build` creates production build, and `npm run lint` checks code quality successfully.

tasks.title: Configure Environment and Deployment
tasks.description: Set up environment variables, Vercel configuration, and deployment pipeline
tasks.details: Create .env.local file with required API keys structure matching .env.example. Configure vercel.json for SvelteKit adapter and environment variables. Set up GitHub Actions workflow for CI/CD with lint, build, and test steps. Configure adapter-vercel in svelte.config.js for optimal Vercel deployment.
tasks.testStrategy: Test local development environment loads correctly, environment variables are accessible, and deployment to Vercel staging succeeds

subtasks.title: Create .env.local template matching .env.example
subtasks.description: Set up local environment variables file with required API key structure
subtasks.details: Create .env.local file based on .env.example template. Include placeholders for all required API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) with clear comments explaining each variable's purpose. Ensure file is properly gitignored and document setup process.

subtasks.title: Configure vercel.json for SvelteKit adapter
subtasks.description: Set up Vercel configuration file for optimal SvelteKit deployment
subtasks.details: Create vercel.json with proper SvelteKit configuration including build settings, environment variable mapping, and routing rules. Configure function regions, memory allocation, and timeout settings for serverless functions.

subtasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow
subtasks.description: Create automated CI/CD pipeline with lint, build, and test steps
subtasks.details: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with Node.js setup, dependency installation, linting with ESLint, TypeScript checking, SvelteKit build process, and test execution. Include deployment to Vercel on main branch push.

subtasks.title: Configure adapter-vercel in svelte.config.js
subtasks.description: Set up SvelteKit adapter for optimal Vercel deployment
subtasks.details: Install and configure @sveltejs/adapter-vercel in svelte.config.js with appropriate prerender settings, edge function configuration, and static file handling. Ensure compatibility with Vercel's serverless environment.

subtasks.title: Test deployment pipeline and environment variable access
subtasks.description: Validate entire deployment process and environment configuration
subtasks.details: Test local development environment with .env.local, verify GitHub Actions workflow execution, validate Vercel deployment success, and confirm environment variables are accessible in both development and production environments. Document any issues and solutions.

tasks.title: Implement Data Models and Types
tasks.description: Define TypeScript interfaces and types for all core entities based on domain model
tasks.details: Create src/types/index.ts with interfaces for Event, User, Topic, Vote, Round, Room, ActivityState, Team, AuditLog. Include proper typing for role-based access (guest, participant, organizer, admin), event status enum, activity types enum (voting, intelligence, discussion, teams), and vote weights (first, second, third). Add validation schemas using zod for runtime type checking.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all types compile correctly, zod schemas validate expected data structures, and type safety is maintained across the application

subtasks.title: Define Core Entity Interfaces
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for Event, User, Topic, and Vote entities
subtasks.details: Define base interfaces for Event (id, title, description, status, createdAt, etc.), User (id, name, email, role, etc.), Topic (id, title, description, submittedBy, votes, etc.), and Vote (id, userId, topicId, weight, timestamp, etc.). Include proper typing for relationships between entities.

subtasks.title: Create Activity State and Role Enums
subtasks.description: Define enums for event status, activity types, user roles, and vote weights
subtasks.details: Create EventStatus enum (draft, active, paused, completed), ActivityType enum (voting, intelligence, discussion, teams), UserRole enum (guest, participant, organizer, admin), and VoteWeight enum (first, second, third). Export all enums with proper TypeScript typing.

subtasks.title: Define Round, Room, and Team Interfaces
subtasks.description: Create interfaces for session management and team organization
subtasks.details: Define Round interface (id, eventId, activityType, startTime, endTime, settings), Room interface (id, eventId, participants, currentActivity, state), and Team interface (id, name, members, roomId, score). Include proper references to core entities and activity states.

subtasks.title: Add AuditLog and Analytics Types
subtasks.description: Create interfaces for audit logging and analytics tracking
subtasks.details: Define AuditLog interface (id, userId, action, entityType, entityId, timestamp, metadata), Analytics interface for event metrics, and ActivityState interface for real-time state management. Include proper typing for action types and metadata structures.

subtasks.title: Install and Configure Zod for Validation
subtasks.description: Set up zod library and create validation schemas for all interfaces
subtasks.details: Install zod package, create validation schemas for all defined interfaces (EventSchema, UserSchema, TopicSchema, VoteSchema, etc.). Add runtime validation functions and error handling for schema validation failures. Include proper type inference from schemas.

subtasks.title: Create Type Exports and Validation Functions
subtasks.description: Organize exports and create utility functions for type validation
subtasks.details: Create centralized exports in src/types/index.ts for all interfaces, enums, and schemas. Add utility functions for type validation, type guards, and data transformation. Include helper functions for role-based access checking and entity relationship validation.

tasks.title: Set Up JSON File Storage System
tasks.description: Implement MVP data persistence layer using JSON files with repository pattern
tasks.details: Create src/lib/storage/ directory with abstract Repository interface and JSONRepository implementation. Implement EventRepository, UserRepository, TopicRepository with CRUD operations. Add file locking mechanism for concurrent access safety. Include data versioning and backup functionality with atomic writes. Create migration utilities for future database transition.
tasks.testStrategy: Test concurrent read/write operations, data integrity after crashes, backup/restore functionality, and repository methods with valid/invalid data

subtasks.title: Create Abstract Repository Interface
subtasks.description: Define base repository interface with common CRUD operations and data validation methods
subtasks.details: Create src/lib/storage/Repository.ts with abstract class defining create, read, update, delete, list, and validate methods. Include TypeScript generics for type safety and error handling interfaces.

subtasks.title: Implement JSONRepository Base Class
subtasks.description: Build base JSON file operations class with file I/O and path management
subtasks.details: Create JSONRepository class extending Repository interface with file read/write operations, JSON parsing/serialization, file path management, and basic error handling for file operations.

subtasks.title: Add File Locking and Atomic Write Mechanisms
subtasks.description: Implement file locking system and atomic write operations for concurrent access safety
subtasks.details: Add file locking using node fs promises with exclusive locks, implement atomic writes using temporary files and rename operations, and add timeout handling for lock acquisition.

subtasks.title: Create EventRepository with CRUD Operations
subtasks.description: Implement event-specific repository with full CRUD operations and event validation
subtasks.details: Build EventRepository extending JSONRepository with event-specific methods, validation rules for event data, search/filter capabilities, and event status management.

subtasks.title: Implement UserRepository and TopicRepository
subtasks.description: Build user and topic repositories with their specific CRUD operations and validation
subtasks.details: Create UserRepository with user management methods, profile handling, and authentication data storage. Build TopicRepository with topic CRUD, voting status tracking, and topic categorization.

subtasks.title: Add Data Versioning and Backup Functionality
subtasks.description: Implement data versioning system with automatic backup creation and rotation
subtasks.details: Add version tracking to data files, implement automatic backup creation before writes, add backup rotation with configurable retention policies, and include backup verification mechanisms.

subtasks.title: Create Migration Utilities
subtasks.description: Build migration system for future database transition and data format changes
subtasks.details: Create migration framework with version tracking, data transformation utilities, rollback capabilities, and export functionality for future database migration.

subtasks.title: Add Comprehensive Error Handling and Recovery
subtasks.description: Implement robust error handling, data corruption detection, and automatic recovery mechanisms
subtasks.details: Add comprehensive error handling for all file operations, implement data corruption detection with checksums, create automatic recovery from backups, and add logging for debugging and monitoring.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication System
tasks.description: Build multi-provider OAuth authentication with guest access support
tasks.details: Install and configure @auth/sveltekit with Google OAuth provider and credentials provider for email/password. Implement guest token generation with secure session management. Create authentication stores using Svelte stores for user state management. Add role-based access control middleware with proper session validation. Implement password reset and account recovery flows.
tasks.testStrategy: Test OAuth flow with Google, guest authentication, password reset functionality, session persistence, and role-based route protection

subtasks.title: Install and Configure @auth/sveltekit
subtasks.description: Set up the core authentication framework with initial configuration
subtasks.details: Install @auth/sveltekit package and configure the base authentication setup with environment variables, secret keys, and basic configuration files. Set up the authentication API routes and initialize the auth system.

subtasks.title: Set Up Google OAuth Provider
subtasks.description: Configure Google OAuth integration for social authentication
subtasks.details: Configure Google OAuth provider with client ID and secret, set up OAuth callbacks, and implement Google sign-in flow. Test the OAuth redirect flow and token exchange process.

subtasks.title: Implement Guest Token Generation and Validation
subtasks.description: Build secure guest access system with token-based authentication
subtasks.details: Create guest token generation system using JWT or similar secure tokens. Implement token validation middleware and guest session management. Ensure proper security measures for anonymous users.

subtasks.title: Create Authentication Stores and Session Management
subtasks.description: Build Svelte stores for user state and session persistence
subtasks.details: Implement Svelte stores for user authentication state, session data, and user profile information. Add session persistence across browser refreshes and proper state synchronization throughout the application.

subtasks.title: Add Role-Based Access Control Middleware
subtasks.description: Implement authorization system with role-based permissions
subtasks.details: Create middleware for route protection based on user roles and permissions. Implement role checking functions and authorization guards for different user types (guest, authenticated, admin). Add proper session validation.

subtasks.title: Implement Password Reset and Account Recovery Flows
subtasks.description: Build password reset and account recovery functionality
subtasks.details: Create password reset flow with email verification, secure token generation, and password update functionality. Implement account recovery options and email templates for password reset communications.

subtasks.title: Add Session Persistence and Security Measures
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive session security and persistence features
subtasks.details: Add session persistence across browser sessions, implement session timeout and refresh mechanisms, and add security measures like CSRF protection, secure cookies, and session invalidation. Include session monitoring and cleanup procedures.

tasks.title: Create WebSocket Real-time Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement WebSocket server and client for real-time activity orchestration
tasks.details: Install socket.io and @types/socket.io. Create WebSocket server in src/lib/websocket/ with event-driven architecture for activity updates, voting updates, game state, and team assignments. Implement client-side socket store with reconnection logic, heartbeat monitoring, and offline detection. Add acknowledgment-based broadcasting with retry mechanisms to meet 1-second propagation target.
tasks.testStrategy: Test WebSocket connection establishment, reconnection after disconnect, message broadcasting to multiple clients, and latency under load with 200 concurrent connections

subtasks.title: Install and Configure Socket.IO Dependencies
subtasks.description: Install socket.io and @types/socket.io packages and set up basic WebSocket server configuration
subtasks.details: Install socket.io and @types/socket.io packages. Create basic WebSocket server configuration in src/lib/websocket/ directory structure. Set up TypeScript types and initial server instance with CORS configuration for cross-origin requests.

subtasks.title: Create Event-Driven Architecture for Activity Updates
subtasks.description: Implement WebSocket event system for activity updates, voting updates, game state, and team assignments
subtasks.details: Design and implement event-driven architecture with typed event handlers for activity updates, voting state changes, game state transitions, and team assignment broadcasts. Create event namespaces and room management for different activity types.

subtasks.title: Implement Client-Side Socket Store with Reconnection Logic
subtasks.description: Create client-side WebSocket store with automatic reconnection and connection state management
subtasks.details: Build client-side socket store using Svelte stores for connection state management. Implement automatic reconnection logic with exponential backoff, connection status indicators, and graceful degradation when offline.

subtasks.title: Add Heartbeat Monitoring and Offline Detection
subtasks.description: Implement heartbeat mechanism and offline detection for reliable connection monitoring
subtasks.details: Create heartbeat ping/pong mechanism between client and server. Implement offline detection with network status monitoring and user feedback for connection issues. Add connection quality indicators and automatic recovery attempts.

subtasks.title: Create Acknowledgment-Based Broadcasting System
subtasks.description: Implement acknowledgment system for reliable message delivery and broadcast confirmation
subtasks.details: Build acknowledgment-based message broadcasting to ensure reliable delivery to all connected clients. Implement message queuing for unacknowledged messages and delivery confirmation tracking to meet 1-second propagation target.

subtasks.title: Implement Retry Mechanisms and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Add comprehensive retry logic and error handling for failed message delivery
subtasks.details: Implement retry mechanisms for failed message deliveries with configurable retry counts and intervals. Add comprehensive error handling for connection failures, message timeouts, and server errors with appropriate user feedback.

subtasks.title: Add Latency Monitoring and Performance Metrics
subtasks.description: Implement latency tracking and performance monitoring for WebSocket communications
subtasks.details: Create latency monitoring system to track message round-trip times and connection performance. Implement metrics collection for monitoring WebSocket performance and identifying bottlenecks to ensure 1-second propagation requirement.

subtasks.title: Create Message Throttling System
subtasks.description: Implement message throttling to limit updates to 2 per second and prevent message flooding
subtasks.details: Build message throttling mechanism to limit client updates to maximum 2 per second. Implement rate limiting with message queuing and batching to prevent server overload while maintaining real-time responsiveness.

subtasks.title: Test Concurrent Connection Handling
subtasks.description: Test and optimize WebSocket server for handling 200 concurrent user connections
subtasks.details: Create comprehensive load testing for 200 concurrent WebSocket connections. Test message broadcasting performance, memory usage, and connection stability under load. Optimize server configuration and implement connection pooling if necessary.

tasks.title: Build Event Management System
tasks.description: Create event creation, configuration, and lifecycle management functionality
tasks.details: Create src/routes/events/ with event CRUD operations. Implement event configuration forms with validation for duration (max 7 days), capacity (min 5 users), and settings. Add QR code generation using qrcode library and unique event code generation. Implement event status state machine (Draft → Active → Completed → Archived) with proper transitions and business rule validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test event creation with various configurations, QR code generation and scanning, event code validation, status transitions, and business rule enforcement

subtasks.title: Create Event CRUD API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Implement REST API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting events with proper request/response handling
subtasks.details: Create src/routes/events/ directory with endpoints for POST /events (create), GET /events (list), GET /events/:id (detail), PUT /events/:id (update), DELETE /events/:id (delete). Include proper error handling, request validation, and response formatting.

subtasks.title: Build Event Configuration Forms with Validation
subtasks.description: Create frontend forms for event configuration with comprehensive validation rules
subtasks.details: Implement event creation and editing forms with validation for duration (max 7 days), capacity (min 5 users), event name, description, and other settings. Include real-time validation feedback and error handling.

subtasks.title: Implement QR Code Generation
subtasks.description: Add QR code generation functionality using qrcode library for event access
subtasks.details: Install qrcode library and implement QR code generation for events. Create endpoint to generate QR codes containing event access information and display them in event management interface.

subtasks.title: Add Unique Event Code Generation and Validation
subtasks.description: Implement system for generating and validating unique event access codes
subtasks.details: Create unique event code generation algorithm (alphanumeric, 6-8 characters). Implement code validation, collision detection, and expiration logic. Add database fields and API endpoints for code management.

subtasks.title: Create Event Status State Machine
subtasks.description: Implement state machine for event lifecycle with proper state transitions
subtasks.details: Design and implement state machine with states: Draft → Active → Completed → Archived. Define valid transitions, implement transition logic, and add state change validation with proper error handling.

subtasks.title: Add Business Rule Validation
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive business rule validation for event constraints
subtasks.details: Add validation for duration limits (max 7 days), capacity constraints (min 5 users), state transition rules, and other business logic. Include server-side validation and appropriate error messages.

subtasks.title: Implement Event Lifecycle Management
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive event lifecycle management system with automated transitions and monitoring
subtasks.details: Implement automated event lifecycle management including scheduled state transitions, event expiration handling, cleanup processes, and monitoring dashboards for event health and status tracking.

tasks.title: Implement Topic Management System
tasks.description: Build topic submission, editing, and management functionality for discussions
tasks.details: Create topic submission forms with real-time validation and character limits. Implement topic editing with proper authorization (only proposer or organizer). Add topic status management (draft/active/frozen) with real-time updates via WebSocket. Include topic tagging system and search functionality. Add organizer controls for topic curation and approval workflows.
tasks.testStrategy: Test topic submission by participants and organizers, real-time updates across clients, edit permissions, status changes, and search functionality

subtasks.title: Create Topic Submission Forms with Validation
subtasks.description: Build topic submission forms with real-time validation, character limits, and input sanitization
subtasks.details: Create Svelte components for topic submission forms with fields for title, description, category, and tags. Implement real-time validation for character limits (title: 100 chars, description: 500 chars), required fields, and content sanitization. Add form state management and error handling with user-friendly messages.

subtasks.title: Implement Topic Editing with Authorization
subtasks.description: Add topic editing functionality with role-based authorization checks
subtasks.details: Create topic editing interface accessible only to topic proposers and organizers. Implement authorization middleware to verify edit permissions before allowing changes. Add edit history tracking and conflict resolution for concurrent edits. Include draft saving functionality for partial edits.

subtasks.title: Add Topic Status Management
subtasks.description: Implement topic lifecycle with draft, active, and frozen status states
subtasks.details: Create status management system with three states: draft (editable, not visible to participants), active (live discussion), and frozen (read-only archive). Add status transition controls for organizers and automatic status changes based on discussion timeline. Include status indicators in topic displays.

subtasks.title: Integrate Real-time Updates via WebSocket
subtasks.description: Add WebSocket integration for real-time topic updates and notifications
subtasks.details: Implement WebSocket event handlers for topic creation, edits, status changes, and new comments. Add real-time notifications for topic updates to subscribed users. Create event broadcasting system for topic changes and ensure proper event ordering and conflict resolution.

subtasks.title: Add Topic Tagging and Search Functionality
subtasks.description: Implement tagging system and search capabilities for topic discovery
subtasks.details: Create tag management system with predefined and custom tags. Implement search functionality with filtering by title, description, tags, status, and author. Add search indexing for performance and autocomplete suggestions. Include advanced search filters and sorting options.

subtasks.title: Create Organizer Curation and Approval Workflows
subtasks.description: Build organizer dashboard for topic curation, approval, and moderation
subtasks.details: Create organizer dashboard with topic queue management, approval workflows, and bulk actions. Implement topic moderation tools including editing, status changes, and deletion capabilities. Add approval notifications and workflow tracking. Include topic analytics and engagement metrics for organizers.

tasks.title: Build Weighted Voting System
tasks.description: Implement 1st/2nd/3rd choice voting with real-time updates and transparency
tasks.details: Create voting interface with drag-and-drop or button-based selection for 1st, 2nd, 3rd choices. Implement vote validation ensuring one vote per weight per user. Add real-time vote counting with WebSocket updates throttled to 2 updates/second. Include vote transparency features showing participant voting status without revealing specific choices. Add voting rule configuration (max votes per topic, voting windows).
tasks.testStrategy: Test vote submission and validation, real-time vote updates, vote weight constraints, transparency features, and concurrent voting by multiple users

subtasks.title: Create Weighted Voting Interface
subtasks.description: Build drag-and-drop or button-based UI for 1st/2nd/3rd choice selection
subtasks.details: Implement voting interface component with drag-and-drop functionality for ranking choices or alternative button-based selection. Include visual indicators for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd choice positions with clear weight distinctions.

subtasks.title: Implement Vote Validation Logic
subtasks.description: Ensure one vote per weight per user with proper validation
subtasks.details: Create validation system to enforce one vote per weight category per user. Implement checks for duplicate votes, weight conflicts, and user authorization before accepting votes.

subtasks.title: Build Real-time Vote Counting System
subtasks.description: Implement WebSocket-based vote counting with live updates
subtasks.details: Create real-time vote counting backend that processes weighted votes and calculates results. Implement WebSocket connections for live vote count updates to all connected clients.

subtasks.title: Add Vote Update Throttling
subtasks.description: Implement 2 updates per second throttling for WebSocket updates
subtasks.details: Add throttling mechanism to limit WebSocket vote updates to maximum 2 per second. Implement update batching and queuing to ensure smooth performance under high voting load.

subtasks.title: Create Vote Transparency Features
subtasks.description: Show participant voting status without revealing specific choices
subtasks.details: Implement transparency system showing who has voted and voting progress without exposing individual vote choices. Create participant status indicators and voting completion tracking.

subtasks.title: Implement Voting Rule Configuration
subtasks.description: Add configuration for max votes per topic and voting windows
subtasks.details: Create configuration system for voting rules including maximum votes per topic, voting time windows, and weight distribution rules. Implement admin interface for rule management.

subtasks.title: Build Voting Status Indicators
subtasks.description: Create visual indicators for voting progress and status
subtasks.details: Implement visual status indicators showing voting progress, remaining time, participant status, and voting rule compliance. Create progress bars and status badges for clear user feedback.

subtasks.title: Test Concurrent Voting Scenarios
subtasks.description: Test system performance under concurrent voting load
subtasks.details: Create comprehensive test suite for concurrent voting scenarios including multiple users voting simultaneously, vote conflicts, and system performance under load. Test throttling effectiveness and data consistency.

tasks.title: Create Activity State Management
tasks.description: Implement activity orchestration system for organizers to switch between voting, games, discussions, and teams
tasks.details: Create ActivityState management with four core activities: voting, group intelligence, discussion groups, and team distribution. Implement organizer dashboard with activity preview and 'Go Live' actions. Add timer configuration and countdown functionality with real-time synchronization. Include activity transition logging in AuditLog with latency metrics and acknowledgment tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test activity switching with sub-1-second propagation to clients, timer functionality, organizer permissions, activity state persistence, and audit logging

subtasks.title: Create ActivityState Core Management System
subtasks.description: Implement core ActivityState class with four activity types: voting, group intelligence, discussion groups, and team distribution
subtasks.details: Create ActivityState enum and management class in src/lib/activity/ with state validation, transition rules, and activity configuration storage. Define interfaces for each activity type with their specific properties and validation rules.

subtasks.title: Build Organizer Dashboard Interface
subtasks.description: Create organizer dashboard with activity preview and 'Go Live' action buttons
subtasks.details: Build dashboard UI in src/routes/organizer/ with activity selection, preview functionality, and 'Go Live' buttons. Include activity status indicators and configuration panels for each activity type.

subtasks.title: Implement Timer Configuration System
subtasks.description: Create timer configuration and countdown functionality for activities
subtasks.details: Build timer management system with configurable durations, countdown display, and automatic activity transitions. Include pause/resume functionality and timer persistence across sessions.

subtasks.title: Add Real-time Activity State Synchronization
subtasks.description: Implement WebSocket-based real-time synchronization of activity state across all clients
subtasks.details: Create WebSocket event handlers for activity state changes, implement broadcast mechanisms for state updates, and ensure sub-1-second propagation to all connected clients.

subtasks.title: Create Activity Transition Logging
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive audit logging for activity transitions with latency metrics
subtasks.details: Add logging to AuditLog system for all activity state changes, capture transition timestamps, measure propagation latency, and store organizer actions with context data.

subtasks.title: Implement Acknowledgment Tracking System
subtasks.description: Build acknowledgment system to track successful broadcast delivery to clients
subtasks.details: Create acknowledgment protocol for activity state broadcasts, implement retry mechanisms for failed deliveries, and maintain delivery status tracking for reliability monitoring.

subtasks.title: Add Organizer Permission Validation
subtasks.description: Implement permission system to validate organizer authority for activity control
subtasks.details: Create role-based permission checks for activity state changes, validate organizer credentials, and implement authorization middleware for activity management endpoints.

subtasks.title: Create State Persistence and Recovery
subtasks.description: Implement activity state persistence and recovery mechanisms for reliability
subtasks.details: Add database persistence for activity states, implement automatic recovery after server restarts, and ensure timer continuity across system interruptions.

subtasks.title: Test Sub-1-Second Propagation Requirement
subtasks.description: Comprehensive testing of activity state propagation performance and reliability
subtasks.details: Create performance tests for activity state broadcasting, measure end-to-end latency, validate sub-1-second propagation requirement, and test with high client loads up to 200 concurrent connections.

tasks.title: Implement Collaborative Word-Chain Game
tasks.description: Build the multiplayer word-chain game for group intelligence activity
tasks.details: Create word-chain game logic where each word starts with the last letter of the previous word. Implement word validation using local dictionary and optional API integration. Add real-time word submission and chain display with WebSocket broadcasting. Include turn-based rotation or simultaneous submission modes with conflict resolution (first valid wins). Add profanity filtering and rate limiting for abuse prevention.
tasks.testStrategy: Test word validation logic, real-time word chain updates, turn management, conflict resolution, profanity filtering, and concurrent player submissions

subtasks.title: Create word-chain game logic and validation
subtasks.description: Implement core game logic for word chaining where each word must start with the last letter of the previous word
subtasks.details: Create game state management, word chain validation rules, and basic game flow logic. Implement functions to check if a word follows the chain rule and track the current game state.

subtasks.title: Implement word validation using dictionary API/local dictionary
subtasks.description: Add word validation system using both local dictionary and optional API integration
subtasks.details: Integrate dictionary API or local word list to validate submitted words. Implement fallback mechanisms and caching for better performance and reliability.

subtasks.title: Add real-time word submission and display
subtasks.description: Implement WebSocket-based real-time word submission and chain display functionality
subtasks.details: Create WebSocket handlers for word submissions and broadcast updates to all connected players. Implement real-time chain display with smooth updates and visual feedback.

subtasks.title: Create turn-based or simultaneous submission modes
subtasks.description: Implement different game modes for turn-based rotation and simultaneous submissions
subtasks.details: Build game mode selection and management. Implement turn rotation logic for turn-based mode and concurrent submission handling for simultaneous mode.

subtasks.title: Implement conflict resolution (first valid wins)
subtasks.description: Add conflict resolution system for handling simultaneous submissions
subtasks.details: Implement timestamp-based conflict resolution where the first valid submission wins. Add proper handling of rejected submissions and user feedback.

subtasks.title: Add profanity filtering and rate limiting
subtasks.description: Implement abuse prevention with profanity filtering and submission rate limiting
subtasks.details: Integrate profanity filter for word submissions and implement rate limiting to prevent spam. Add user reporting and moderation features for inappropriate content.

subtasks.title: Create game UI with chain timeline and input validation
subtasks.description: Build the user interface for the word-chain game with visual chain display and input validation
subtasks.details: Create responsive game interface with word chain timeline, input field with validation feedback, player status indicators, and game controls. Include visual cues for turn order and submission status.

tasks.title: Build Discussion Group Assignment System
tasks.description: Implement automatic participant assignment to discussion rooms based on voting preferences
tasks.details: Create algorithm to assign participants to discussion topics based on 1st, 2nd, 3rd choice votes. Implement room capacity management and overflow handling. Add manual assignment override capabilities for organizers. Include room information display with capacity and amenities. Create round management with history tracking and participant notification system.
tasks.testStrategy: Test assignment algorithm with various voting scenarios, room capacity limits, manual overrides, round transitions, and participant notifications

subtasks.title: Create Assignment Algorithm for Vote Preferences
subtasks.description: Implement core algorithm to assign participants to discussion topics based on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd choice votes
subtasks.details: Build assignment algorithm that processes participant voting preferences and optimally assigns users to discussion rooms. Include logic for handling preference conflicts, maximizing satisfaction based on vote weights (1st choice = 3 points, 2nd = 2 points, 3rd = 1 point), and ensuring fair distribution across topics.

subtasks.title: Implement Room Capacity Management
subtasks.description: Build room capacity tracking and overflow handling system
subtasks.details: Create room capacity management system that tracks current occupancy, enforces maximum limits, and handles overflow scenarios. Implement queuing system for overflow participants and automatic reassignment when rooms become available.

subtasks.title: Add Manual Assignment Override System
subtasks.description: Create organizer interface for manual participant assignment overrides

subtasks.title: Test Assignment Scenarios and Edge Cases

subtasks.title: Implement random distribution strategy with constraints

subtasks.title: Add mix for collaboration strategy with category balancing

subtasks.title: Create manual override functionality

subtasks.title: Add team preview with validation warnings

subtasks.title: Implement late joiner handling and suggestions

subtasks.title: Create team assignment broadcast and confirmation tracking

subtasks.title: Add audit trail for privacy actions
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive audit logging system for all privacy-related actions and data operations
subtasks.details: Design audit log schema to capture all privacy-related events (exports, deletions, consent changes). Implement audit logging middleware for automatic event capture. Create audit trail viewing interface for compliance officers. Add tamper-proof logging with cryptographic signatures and retention guarantees.

subtasks.title: Implement data portability features
subtasks.description: Build data portability system allowing users to transfer their data to external services
subtasks.details: Create standardized data export formats compatible with common platforms. Implement secure data transfer mechanisms with API integrations. Add data validation and integrity checks for portability. Include user-friendly interface for initiating and monitoring data transfers with progress tracking.

subtasks.title: Test compliance workflows and validation
subtasks.description: Comprehensive testing of all GDPR compliance features and workflows to ensure legal requirements are met
subtasks.details: Create test suite for data export accuracy and completeness. Test data deletion and anonymization workflows. Validate consent logging and privacy notice functionality. Test automated cleanup and retention policies. Verify audit trail completeness and integrity. Conduct compliance validation against GDPR requirements.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Monitoring
tasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling, logging, and monitoring infrastructure
tasks.details: Implement centralized error handling with user-friendly error messages and fallback behaviors. Add structured logging with error categorization and context tracking. Configure monitoring dashboards for WebSocket success rates, activity switch latency, and error budgets. Include automated alerting for critical failures and performance degradation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test error handling across all user flows, logging accuracy, monitoring dashboards, alert triggers, and graceful degradation scenarios

subtasks.title: Implement Centralized Error Handling System
subtasks.description: Create centralized error handling infrastructure with user-friendly error messages and standardized error response formats
subtasks.details: Build error handling middleware and utilities that capture, categorize, and format errors consistently across the application. Implement user-friendly error messages that hide technical details while providing actionable guidance. Create error boundaries for UI components and API endpoints.

subtasks.title: Add Structured Logging with Error Categorization
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive logging system with error categorization and context tracking
subtasks.details: Set up structured logging with appropriate log levels (error, warn, info, debug). Implement error categorization system to classify errors by type, severity, and source. Add context tracking to capture user actions, session data, and system state during errors.

subtasks.title: Create Monitoring Dashboards for WebSocket and Performance Metrics
subtasks.description: Build monitoring dashboards to track WebSocket success rates, activity switch latency, and error budgets
subtasks.details: Implement monitoring infrastructure to track key performance indicators including WebSocket connection success rates, message delivery latency, activity switching performance, and error rate budgets. Create visual dashboards for real-time monitoring and historical analysis.

subtasks.title: Implement Automated Alerting for Critical Failures
subtasks.description: Set up automated alerting system for critical failures and performance degradation
subtasks.details: Configure alerting rules for critical system failures, performance threshold breaches, and error rate spikes. Implement notification channels (email, SMS, webhook) with escalation policies. Set up alert suppression to prevent notification fatigue and ensure alerts are actionable.

subtasks.title: Add Graceful Degradation for Connection Failures
subtasks.description: Implement graceful degradation mechanisms for WebSocket and network connection failures
subtasks.details: Build fallback mechanisms for WebSocket connection failures including automatic reconnection with exponential backoff. Implement offline mode capabilities and queue management for failed operations. Add user feedback for connection status and degraded functionality.

subtasks.title: Create Error Recovery Mechanisms
subtasks.description: Develop automated error recovery and manual recovery options for system failures
subtasks.details: Implement automatic recovery mechanisms for transient errors and connection issues. Create manual recovery options for users when automatic recovery fails. Add retry logic with circuit breaker patterns and implement data synchronization after recovery.

subtasks.title: Test Error Scenarios and Monitoring Accuracy
subtasks.description: Comprehensive testing of error handling, monitoring systems, and recovery mechanisms
subtasks.details: Create comprehensive test suite for error scenarios including network failures, server errors, and edge cases. Validate monitoring accuracy and alert triggering. Test recovery mechanisms and graceful degradation. Perform load testing to ensure error handling performs under stress.

tasks.title: Build Testing Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive testing suite including unit, integration, and E2E tests
tasks.details: Set up Vitest for unit testing and Playwright for E2E testing. Create test utilities for mocking WebSocket connections and authentication. Implement tests for core user journeys: join & vote, orchestrate activities, distribute teams, and monitor platform health. Add load testing simulation for 200 concurrent participants. Configure CI/CD integration with test automation.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify test coverage meets requirements, load tests handle target concurrent users, E2E tests cover critical paths, and CI/CD pipeline runs all tests successfully

subtasks.title: Set up Vitest for unit testing
subtasks.description: Configure Vitest testing framework for unit tests with proper configuration and test environment setup
subtasks.details: Install Vitest and configure vitest.config.js with proper TypeScript support, coverage settings, and test environment. Set up test utilities for common mocking patterns and assertion helpers. Configure test scripts in package.json and establish testing folder structure.

subtasks.title: Configure Playwright for E2E testing
subtasks.description: Set up Playwright for end-to-end testing with browser configuration and test environment
subtasks.details: Install Playwright and configure playwright.config.js with multiple browser support (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit). Set up test environment with proper base URLs, timeouts, and retry configurations. Create page object models for common UI interactions and establish E2E test folder structure.

subtasks.title: Create test utilities for WebSocket and auth mocking
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive mocking utilities for WebSocket connections and authentication flows
subtasks.details: Create mock WebSocket server utilities for testing real-time features. Implement authentication mocking helpers for different user roles and session states. Build test fixtures for common data scenarios and create helper functions for setup/teardown of test environments.

subtasks.title: Implement tests for core user journeys
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive tests covering join & vote, orchestrate activities, distribute teams, and monitor platform health
subtasks.details: Write E2E tests for user onboarding flow, voting mechanisms, activity orchestration, and team distribution. Create integration tests for real-time synchronization and state management. Include tests for error scenarios and edge cases in each user journey.

subtasks.title: Add load testing for 200 concurrent users
subtasks.description: Implement load testing infrastructure to simulate 200 concurrent participants
subtasks.details: Set up load testing framework (Artillery or k6) to simulate concurrent user sessions. Create realistic load testing scenarios for WebSocket connections, voting activities, and real-time interactions. Configure performance monitoring and establish baseline metrics for acceptable performance thresholds.

subtasks.title: Create CI/CD integration with test automation
subtasks.description: Configure continuous integration pipeline with automated test execution and reporting
subtasks.details: Set up GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipeline to run unit tests, E2E tests, and load tests on pull requests and deployments. Configure test result reporting, coverage reporting, and failure notifications. Include parallel test execution and caching for optimal pipeline performance.

subtasks.title: Add accessibility testing with axe-core
subtasks.description: Implement automated accessibility testing to ensure WCAG compliance
subtasks.details: Install and configure axe-core for automated accessibility testing. Integrate accessibility checks into E2E test suite and create specific accessibility test scenarios. Set up reporting for accessibility violations and establish accessibility standards for the platform.

subtasks.title: Test coverage validation and reporting
subtasks.description: Set up comprehensive test coverage tracking and reporting with quality gates
subtasks.details: Configure code coverage collection with Istanbul/c8 and set coverage thresholds (minimum 80% coverage). Create coverage reports in multiple formats (HTML, JSON, LCOV) and integrate with CI/CD pipeline. Set up coverage quality gates to prevent deployment of under-tested code.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Loading
tasks.description: Implement performance optimizations to meet loading and interaction targets
tasks.details: Optimize bundle size with code splitting and dynamic imports. Implement lazy loading for non-critical components and images. Add performance monitoring with Core Web Vitals tracking (LCP < 2.5s target). Optimize WebSocket connection management and implement connection pooling. Add caching strategies for static assets and API responses.
tasks.testStrategy: Test loading performance on mid-tier mobile devices, measure Core Web Vitals, verify code splitting effectiveness, and validate caching behavior

subtasks.title: Implement code splitting and dynamic imports
subtasks.description: Set up webpack/Vite code splitting with dynamic imports for route-based and component-based splitting
subtasks.details: Configure SvelteKit for automatic code splitting, implement dynamic imports for heavy components and routes, set up chunk optimization for optimal bundle sizes

subtasks.title: Add lazy loading for components and images
subtasks.description: Implement lazy loading strategies for non-critical UI components and image assets
subtasks.details: Create lazy loading wrapper components, implement intersection observer for image lazy loading, add skeleton loading states for better UX

subtasks.title: Configure Core Web Vitals monitoring
subtasks.description: Set up performance monitoring with LCP target under 2.5 seconds
subtasks.details: Integrate web-vitals library, implement Core Web Vitals tracking (LCP, FID, CLS), set up performance dashboard and alerting for target thresholds

subtasks.title: Optimize WebSocket connection management
subtasks.description: Implement efficient WebSocket connection handling with pooling and reconnection strategies
subtasks.details: Add connection pooling for WebSocket connections, implement automatic reconnection with exponential backoff, optimize message queuing and batching

subtasks.title: Implement caching strategies
subtasks.description: Add comprehensive caching for static assets and API responses
subtasks.details: Configure HTTP caching headers, implement service worker caching for static assets, add API response caching with appropriate TTL and invalidation strategies

subtasks.title: Optimize bundle size
subtasks.description: Analyze and reduce overall bundle size through tree shaking and dependency optimization
subtasks.details: Run bundle analysis, remove unused dependencies, implement tree shaking optimizations, analyze and optimize third-party library imports

subtasks.title: Test performance on mobile devices
subtasks.description: Validate performance optimizations on mid-tier mobile devices and various network conditions
subtasks.details: Test loading performance on mid-tier mobile devices, validate Core Web Vitals metrics, test under throttled network conditions, ensure performance targets are met

tasks.title: Create Documentation and Help System
tasks.description: Build comprehensive user documentation with tutorials and troubleshooting guides
tasks.details: Create in-app help system with contextual guidance and tooltips. Build comprehensive documentation covering setup, configuration, and user workflows. Add video walkthrough tutorials for key features. Implement FAQ system with search functionality. Create troubleshooting guides for common issues and connectivity problems.
tasks.testStrategy: Test help system accessibility, documentation completeness, video tutorial clarity, FAQ search functionality, and troubleshooting guide effectiveness

subtasks.title: Create In-App Help System with Contextual Guidance
subtasks.description: Implement contextual help system with tooltips and guided interactions throughout the application
subtasks.details: Build in-app help overlay system with contextual tooltips for key UI elements. Create guided tour functionality for first-time users. Implement help trigger buttons and contextual help panels that appear based on user location in the app. Add help content management system for easy updates.

subtasks.title: Build Comprehensive Setup and User Workflow Documentation
subtasks.description: Create detailed documentation covering installation, configuration, and all user workflows
subtasks.details: Write comprehensive documentation in markdown format covering system requirements, installation steps, initial configuration, and detailed user workflows for each feature. Create API documentation and developer guides. Organize documentation with clear navigation and search functionality.

subtasks.title: Add Video Tutorial Creation and Integration
subtasks.description: Create video walkthrough tutorials for key features and integrate them into the documentation system
subtasks.details: Record video tutorials for core features including event creation, activity management, and user participation flows. Implement video player integration within documentation. Create video hosting solution and ensure videos are accessible and properly captioned for accessibility compliance.

subtasks.title: Implement FAQ System with Search Functionality
subtasks.description: Build searchable FAQ system with categorized questions and answers
subtasks.details: Create FAQ database structure with categories, tags, and search indexing. Implement search functionality with keyword matching and relevance scoring. Build FAQ management interface for adding and updating questions. Add FAQ integration points throughout the application for contextual help.

subtasks.title: Create Troubleshooting Guides for Common Issues
subtasks.description: Develop comprehensive troubleshooting documentation for connectivity and common user problems
subtasks.details: Create troubleshooting guides for WebSocket connectivity issues, browser compatibility problems, and common user errors. Implement diagnostic tools for users to test their connection and system compatibility. Add error code reference guide and step-by-step resolution procedures.

tasks.title: Implement Backup and Recovery System
tasks.description: Add automated backup, disaster recovery, and data integrity verification
tasks.details: Implement automated backup system with 30-minute intervals and 7-day retention. Create disaster recovery procedures with 30-minute RTO target. Add data integrity verification with checksums and corruption detection. Implement backup restoration testing and validation procedures. Include backup monitoring and alerting for failures.
tasks.testStrategy: Test backup creation and restoration, data integrity verification, disaster recovery procedures, and backup monitoring alerts

subtasks.title: Implement Automated Backup System with 30-minute Intervals
subtasks.description: Create automated backup functionality that runs every 30 minutes with 7-day retention policy
subtasks.details: Set up scheduled backup jobs using cron or similar scheduling mechanism. Implement backup creation logic that captures application data, database state, and configuration files. Configure 30-minute interval timing and implement 7-day retention policy with automatic cleanup of old backups. Include backup metadata tracking and file organization.

subtasks.title: Create Disaster Recovery Procedures with 30-minute RTO
subtasks.description: Develop disaster recovery procedures and automation to meet 30-minute Recovery Time Objective
subtasks.details: Design and document disaster recovery procedures including failover processes, data restoration steps, and service recovery workflows. Implement automated recovery scripts and procedures to minimize downtime. Create recovery playbooks and ensure 30-minute RTO compliance through testing and optimization.

subtasks.title: Add Data Integrity Verification with Checksums
subtasks.description: Implement data integrity verification using checksums and corruption detection
subtasks.details: Create checksum generation for all backup files using SHA-256 or similar cryptographic hash functions. Implement corruption detection mechanisms that verify data integrity before and after backup operations. Add automated integrity checks that run during backup creation and restoration processes.

subtasks.title: Implement Backup Restoration and Validation
subtasks.description: Build backup restoration functionality with comprehensive validation procedures
subtasks.details: Create backup restoration workflows that can restore from any valid backup point. Implement validation procedures to verify restored data integrity and completeness. Add restoration testing automation that validates backup quality and restoration success. Include rollback capabilities for failed restoration attempts.

subtasks.title: Create Backup Monitoring and Alerting
subtasks.description: Implement monitoring system with alerting for backup failures and issues
subtasks.details: Set up monitoring for backup job success/failure rates, backup file integrity, and storage capacity. Implement alerting system that notifies administrators of backup failures, corruption detection, or storage issues. Create monitoring dashboards with backup health metrics and historical trend analysis.

subtasks.title: Test Backup and Recovery Procedures
subtasks.description: Conduct comprehensive testing of backup creation, restoration, and disaster recovery procedures
subtasks.details: Perform end-to-end testing of backup creation, data integrity verification, and restoration processes. Conduct disaster recovery drills to validate RTO compliance and procedure effectiveness. Test backup monitoring alerts and validate restoration under various failure scenarios. Document test results and refine procedures based on findings.

tasks.title: Conduct Security Audit and Penetration Testing
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive security assessment and vulnerability testing
tasks.details: Conduct security audit covering authentication, authorization, data protection, and API security. Perform penetration testing on WebSocket connections, real-time features, and admin interfaces. Test for common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) and implement fixes. Add security scanning to CI/CD pipeline. Document security procedures and incident response plans.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify no critical security vulnerabilities exist, all authentication flows are secure, data encryption works correctly, and security scanning passes in CI/CD

subtasks.title: Conduct Authentication and Authorization Security Audit
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive security assessment of authentication flows, session management, and authorization controls
subtasks.details: Audit all authentication mechanisms including login/logout flows, session token handling, password policies, and multi-factor authentication if implemented. Review authorization logic for role-based access control (guest, participant, organizer, admin). Test for privilege escalation vulnerabilities, session fixation, and authentication bypass scenarios. Validate secure storage of credentials and proper session timeout handling.

subtasks.title: Perform WebSocket and Real-time Feature Penetration Testing
subtasks.description: Conduct specialized security testing of WebSocket connections and real-time communication features
subtasks.details: Test WebSocket authentication and authorization mechanisms. Perform injection attacks through WebSocket messages. Test for message tampering, replay attacks, and unauthorized access to real-time channels. Validate rate limiting on WebSocket connections and message flooding prevention. Test reconnection security and session hijacking scenarios.

subtasks.title: Test for OWASP Top 10 Vulnerabilities
subtasks.description: Systematically test application against OWASP Top 10 security risks
subtasks.details: Test for injection vulnerabilities (SQL, NoSQL, XSS, command injection). Verify authentication and session management security. Test for sensitive data exposure and XML external entities. Validate access control implementations. Test for security misconfigurations, known vulnerable components, and insufficient logging. Verify proper error handling without information disclosure.

subtasks.title: Audit Admin Interface and Elevated Privilege Scenarios
subtasks.description: Perform security testing of administrative functions and privilege escalation scenarios
subtasks.details: Test admin-only functionality for proper access controls. Attempt privilege escalation from guest to participant to organizer to admin roles. Validate admin event management, user management, and system configuration security. Test for horizontal privilege escalation between events and organizations. Verify admin audit logging and sensitive operation validation.

subtasks.title: Add Security Scanning to CI/CD Pipeline
subtasks.description: Integrate automated security scanning tools into the continuous integration pipeline
subtasks.details: Configure SAST (Static Application Security Testing) tools like ESLint security plugins, Semgrep, or Sonar. Add dependency vulnerability scanning with npm audit or Snyk. Implement DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing) for automated penetration testing. Configure security scanning to run on every pull request and deployment. Set up security gates to prevent deployment of vulnerable code.

subtasks.title: Document Security Procedures and Incident Response
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive security documentation and incident response procedures
subtasks.details: Document security architecture, threat model, and security controls. Create incident response playbook including detection, containment, eradication, and recovery procedures. Document security monitoring and alerting procedures. Create security training materials for development team. Establish security review process for code changes and new features.

subtasks.title: Create Vulnerability Remediation Plan
subtasks.description: Develop prioritized plan for addressing discovered security vulnerabilities
subtasks.details: Catalog all discovered vulnerabilities with CVSS scores and risk ratings. Create remediation timeline based on risk severity and business impact. Develop implementation plan for security fixes including code changes, configuration updates, and infrastructure modifications. Assign responsibility for each vulnerability remediation and track progress.

subtasks.title: Validate All Security Fixes and Controls
subtasks.description: Verify implementation and effectiveness of all security measures and vulnerability fixes
subtasks.details: Re-test all previously identified vulnerabilities to confirm remediation. Validate security controls are functioning as designed through penetration testing. Verify CI/CD security scanning is detecting vulnerabilities correctly. Test incident response procedures through tabletop exercises. Conduct final security assessment to ensure no new vulnerabilities were introduced during remediation.
